from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from rest_framework_guardian.filters import ObjectPermissionsFilter
from .models import MedicalTranscript
from .serializers import MedicalTranscriptSerializer

class MedicalTranscriptSearchView(generics.ListAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    filter_backends = [ObjectPermissionsFilter]
    serializer_class = MedicalTranscriptSerializer
    queryset = MedicalTranscript.objects.all()

    def filter_queryset(self, queryset):
        # Apply guardian ObjectPermissionsFilter first, then narrow down the filtered queryset
        qs = super().filter_queryset(queryset)
        search_query = self.request.query_params.get('q', '')
        if search_query:
            qs = qs.filter(diagnosis_notes__icontains=search_query)
        return qs
